model: GTFS pattern graph with mean-headway waiting
walking_access_interpretation: No maximum walking distance for initial access or final egress; every accepted walking second is charged.
transfer_walking_interpretation: Automatic inter-stop links use a 0.4km approximate walking radius and geometry checks; explicit GTFS transfer links and chained walks remain. This is not a total interchange-walk cap.

routing_diagnostics.routing_algorithm: batched temporary origins plus chunked min-plus egress

mode_array_definitions.transit_seconds: Minimum modeled walk-access + boarding wait + actual GTFS ride(s), dwell/transfers + walk-egress. At least one ride required; diagonal and absent candidates are infinity.
mode_array_definitions.transit_access_seconds: For uncapped output: selected initial walking time plus entrance_seconds, fully included in transit_seconds.
mode_array_definitions.transit_egress_seconds: For uncapped output: selected final walking time plus entrance_seconds exit buffer, fully included in transit_seconds.
mode_array_definitions.transit_first_boarding_stop_index: For uncapped output: zero-based index into transit_stop_ids; -1 when no transit candidate or on the diagonal.
mode_array_definitions.transit_last_alighting_stop_index: For uncapped output: zero-based index into transit_stop_ids; -1 when no transit candidate or on the diagonal.
mode_array_definitions.transit_access_barrier_flag: For uncapped flag_only output: selected access chord fails supplied land/water screen; false under reject policy because such legs are excluded. False is not validation against streets or barriers outside supplied geometry.
mode_array_definitions.transit_egress_barrier_flag: Same as transit_access_barrier_flag, for selected egress chord.
mode_array_definitions.transit_access_exceeds_legacy_radius: For uncapped output: selected initial walking distance exceeds old mode-specific bus_access_km/rail_access_km radius. Exit/entrance buffer is excluded from this distance comparison.
mode_array_definitions.transit_egress_exceeds_legacy_radius: Same as transit_access_exceeds_legacy_radius, for final walking leg.

limitations: Expected-time graph, not exact departure-time or real-time routing; median rides and half mean headway are approximations.
Exact stop-sequence patterns are separate: splitting service patterns can overestimate waiting when several patterns serve the same journey.
Walking is great-circle distance times a detour factor, not a street/bridge/pedestrian-access route.
walk_seconds is the complete distance approximation, including potentially impossible pedestrian water crossings; use walk_barrier_checked_seconds for conservative barrier filtering.
Without supplied land/water geometry, pedestrian legs have not been checked for water barriers. Supplied water coverage is limited to downloaded counties.
When supplied, land-chord checks are conservative: they may reject genuine bridge or indirect land paths.
Pickup/drop-off types 1, 2 and 3 are unavailable to unrestricted riders in this model.
Interlining, timed transfers, schedule correlations, crowding, service reliability, and accessibility are not modeled.

GTFS minimum-transfer rules conservatively delay all onward transfers from affected arrival states; prohibitions disable all onward transfers there. This prevents walking via a third stop from bypassing a rule, but can overestimate journeys unaffected by the original rule.
Transit requires at least one actual GTFS ride edge; absent service stays infinite; no invented transit fallback.
